We scan your source code, cloud, and runtime to show you which vulnerabilities are actually important to solve. With Noon, our modern workforce security platform, we also protect your people: securing inboxes, protecting devices, governing AI use, and training your teams. Security is built into the fabric of our products, team, infrastructure, and processes, so you can rest assured your data is safeguarded. **Policies and procedures both apply to Aikido and Noon.** ## Subprocessors | | | --- | | Amazon Web Services
